description: Fixed tool-call inputs for GHSA-5648-rgj9-v224 (F1: execute_graphql read-only + allow-list bypass). Queries are GraphQL request documents only; no credentials are present.

attack_queries.note: Comma is an ignored GraphQL token, so the document is a valid mutation, but the pre-fix guard regex accepts the operation type only after ^, } or ;.
A leading comment is collapsed into a single space, so the normalized document starts with the comma and escapes the same regex.
attack_queries.query:
# queue the maintenance mutation
,mutation DeleteProject { deleteProject(input: {project: "424242"}) { errors } }

attack_queries.note: Same separator defect on a second operation: a comma in front of the operation type is not recognised as a document boundary.
attack_queries.query: query CurrentUser { currentUser { username } },subscription { projectUpdated { id } }

attack_queries.note: Control case that the pre-fix guard already rejects; both revisions must classify it as a write operation.

benign_queries.note: Ordinary read-only query that must stay allowed in read-only mode.
Read-only query with an argument and nested selection set.
benign_queries.query: query ProjectMeta { project(fullPath: "group/allowed") { id name description } }

benign_queries.note: Field name containing the literal token 'subscription'; a conservative parser must not treat it as an operation type.
Alias whose name contains 'mutation'; selection sets and argument names must not be mistaken for operation types.
benign_queries.query: query Audit { mutationEvents: auditEvents(first: 5) { id action } }
